en.headline: Hang Seng Index opens 0.32 percent lower at 23,452
en.dek: The benchmark dropped 74 points in early trading on Wednesday as technology and consumer shares weighed on sentiment.
body: The Hang Seng Index opened lower on Wednesday, falling 74 points, or 0.32 percent, to 23,452.

Technology and consumer-related shares led the early declines, with the Hang Seng Tech Index also easing. Mainland indices opened mixed, while markets elsewhere in Asia were mixed amid attention to the results of the US midterm elections.
The move followed three consecutive days of gains in the local market. Trading volumes at the open were moderate as investors assessed overnight developments.

zh.headline: 恒生指數低開0.32% 報23452點
zh.dek: 周三早段恒指下跌74點，科技及消費股拖累氣氛，投資者關注美國中期選舉結果。
body: 恒生指數周三低開，下跌74點或0.32%，報23452點。
科技及消費相關股份早段領跌，恒生科技指數亦回軟。內地股市開市表現不一，亞洲其他市場亦有升有跌，市場關注美國中期選舉開票進展。
本地股市此前已連續三日上升。開市時成交額屬中等水平，投資者正評估隔夜外圍發展。
